events_detected.title: US-Japan Joint FX Intervention (First in 28 Years)
events_detected.summary: US Treasury and Japan MOF conducted coordinated yen-buying intervention. First joint operation in over a decade. Driven by yen collapse toward 4-decade low spilling into Treasury market stress. FIMA repo facility used to avoid forced Treasury selling.

events_detected.title: Strait of Hormuz Deal Imminent - De-escalation
events_detected.summary: Iran and Oman in final stages of drafting agreement on Hormuz shipping routes. 60-day interim mechanism with northern lane for inbound, southern for outbound. No tolls on commercial shipping.

events_detected.title: Ebola PHEIC Escalating - DRC + Uganda
events_detected.summary: WHO PHEIC declared May 16. 3,973 confirmed cases, 1,801 deaths as of Aug 6. Treatment centers at 139% capacity. Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine.

events_detected.title: Russia Banking Crisis Accelerating
events_detected.summary: Sberbank NPLs at 5.5%. Bankruptcies +13.7% YoY. Record 636,000 personal bankruptcies. Sber cut GDP forecast to 0-0.5%. Kremlin think tank warns systemic crisis.

events_detected.title: Korean Won Surges 8.8% - Fastest Since Financial Crisis
events_detected.summary: South Korea joined US-Japan joint FX intervention. Won surged 8.8% - steepest since 2008. Carry trade unwinding risks persist.

events_detected.title: OPEC+ Completes Full Rollback of Voluntary Production Cuts
events_detected.summary: OPEC+ raising quotas by 188,000 bpd in September, completing rollback of 2023 voluntary cuts. Timed to offset Iran war supply disruption.
